theorems.name: Submission.dor_zdm_imrep_zero_structure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U 0), R.carrier.Countable ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (R.carrier ∩ K).Finite ∧ R.measure K ≠ ∞) ∧ (∀ x ∈ R.carrier, (∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt 0 R.carrier x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (R.orient x) Q) ∧ R.orient x ≠ 0) ∧ (IsOpen U → U ∩ R.measure.support = R.carrier)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
